stem: How did the development of Velcro differ from the development of the water-collection panels?

options.label: A
options.text: The water-collection panels took years to create, while Velcro was created in a short period of time.

options.label: B
options.text: The water-collection panels are made of synthetic materials, while Velcro is made of natural materials.

options.label: C
options.text: The design of the water-collection panels has changed many times, while the design of Velcro has changed very little.

options.label: D
options.text: The water-collection panels are intended to solve a specific problem, while Velcro is designed to be applied in many different situations.
